baseline_identities.no_hold_reference: open HOLD layer disabled; always executes the legal upstream target (models={})
baseline_identities.active_hold_baseline: legacy rules-only open policy on legacy_models

intraday_provider.purpose: common observed price vintage for source-stability diagnosis; not PIT or broker-share qualification

execution_mark_provider.purpose: native accounting reconciliation of prescribed opening and first-hour-close target schedules

coherent_provider.purpose: coherent native daily-prefix/intraday-suffix mark and quantity continuation

early_field_repair.note: all first-hour fields are rebuilt together from one repaired source in the covered region; the unmatched prefix carries no recovery

legacy_identity_parity.note: original frame + same legacy models/spec reproduce source 17 per day; uniform-vintage differences are then input-vintage sensitivity

empirical_prior.note: illegal rows have lower label variance and ~5% of the top decile; the strong 'illegal rows dominate the extremes' premise is NOT supported
empirical_prior.framing: pre-declared decision-time legality contrast, not proof that filtering removes noise

gates.note: full frozen gate set; a missing reference is needs_data, never skipped
